name: Alert
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Alert(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

AlertAction.description: A trailing row for buttons: below the text in the block layout, after it inline.

AlertIcon.description: A leading icon slot; the icon takes the variant's accent color.

AlertTitle.description: The headline, an <h5> by default - pick the level that fits the page outline with `as:`.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes:
The neutral default variant with an icon, title and description. Change the variant,
layout and dismiss button live.

examples.name: Variants
examples.notes: Seven variants color the alert for its purpose; the AlertIcon inherits the accent.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-3") do
    VARIANTS.each do |variant, icon, title, description|
      Alert(variant:) do
        AlertIcon { Icon(icon) }
        AlertTitle { title }
        AlertDescription { description }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Inline layout
examples.notes:
`layout: :inline` flows the icon, title and description onto one row once there's room.
The alert is container-query aware, so it stacks again when narrow - try the mobile viewport.

examples.name: With actions
examples.notes: An AlertAction row holds buttons - below the text in the block layout, trailing inline.

examples.name: Dismissible
examples.notes:
`dismissible: true` adds a close button; the alert animates out when closed. Give it a
`persist_key:` to remember the dismissal across visits (localStorage, or
`persist_storage: :session`).

examples.name: Controlled
examples.notes:
Drive visibility from outside through `data-appica-ui--alert-open-value`, and listen for
`appica-ui--alert:open-change` - here to offer a button that brings a dismissed alert back.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-md flex-col items-center gap-4") do
    div(class: "w-full") do
      Alert(variant: :info, dismissible: true, id: "controlled-alert") do
        AlertIcon { Icon(:info_circle_filled) }
        AlertTitle { "Good to know" }
        AlertDescription { "This banner is controlled. Dismiss it and bring it back below." }
      end
    end
    Button(variant: :outline, size: :sm, id: "show-alert", hidden: true) { "Show alert" }
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(<<~JS)
      const box = document.getElementById("controlled-alert").parentElement
      const show = document.getElementById("show-alert")

      box.addEventListener("appica-ui--alert:open-change", ({ detail }) => show.hidden = detail.open)
      show.addEventListener("click", () => box.setAttribute("data-appica-ui--alert-open-value", "true"))
    JS
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes:
The icon moves to the right, the dismiss button to the left and the actions align to the
start edge - all from logical properties.
